summary: A party chair can offer a parade vehicle without committing volunteers to build a float.
realLife: When a state official’s office asked about the fair parade, Moss offered to help locate a vehicle. The county committee decided against making a float.
inGame: needs: the parade request, the committee’s decision and any confirmed vehicle.

turns.what: The chair passes the contact to the organizer.
turns.pulledBy: A local owner agrees to supply a vehicle and driver.
turns.writesBack: The schedule lists a ride with no float-building assignment.

turns.pulledBy: The guest’s office says transport is already arranged.
turns.writesBack: The volunteers who offered help keep their day free.
